item.title: Week of 2026-09-14: 13 alive / 31 fading / 29 dead — what changed
item.description: Week of 2026-09-14: 13 alive / 31 fading / 29 dead — what changed
item.content:encoded:
• This run covers 140 strategy/asset/timeframe rows: 13 ALIVE, 31 FADING, 29 DEAD, 15 with too few trades.
  • 11 verdict(s) changed since the 2026-09-07 run.
  • Among rows with at least 30 out-of-sample trades, the highest was 996.08 (DCA bot (3Commas-style safety orders) (sostep1.5) on ETHUSD 1d); the lowest was 0.39 (Grid bot (Pionex-style spot grid) (range30-grid20) on ETHUSD 1d).

Verdict changes

  • Price above SMA (n50) on ETHUSD 4h: FADING → DEAD
  • Bollinger breakout (20-2) on BTCUSD 4h: FADING → DEAD
  • Bollinger mean reversion (20-2) on BTCUSD 1d: FADING → DEAD
  • Donchian/Turtle breakout (20-10) on ETHUSD 4h: ALIVE → FADING
  • EMA 9/21 crossover (9-21) on BTCUSD 4h: FADING → DEAD
  • Grid bot (Pionex-style spot grid) (range20-grid20) on BTCUSD 4h: DEAD → FADING
  • Grid bot (Pionex-style spot grid) (range30-grid20) on BTCUSD 4h: DEAD → ALIVE
  • Grid bot (Pionex-style spot grid) (range20-grid20) on ETHUSD 4h: FADING → DEAD
  • Ichimoku cloud breakout (9-26-52) on BTCUSD 4h: FADING → DEAD
  • Supertrend (10-3) on BTCUSD 4h: ALIVE → FADING
  • Time-series momentum (n90) on ETHUSD 4h: ALIVE → FADING

Biggest fee drag: 673.5% on DCA bot (3Commas-style safety orders) (sostep1.5) on ETHUSD 1d.
